name: biomart
description: Ensembl BioMart — genomic annotations, identifier translation, and cross-reference queries.

name: pubmed
description: PubMed biomedical literature — search, metadata, abstracts, full-text (PMC), related articles, ID conversion, copyright status, citation lookup.

name: clinical-trials
description: ClinicalTrials.gov — trial search, details, endpoints, sponsor/investigator/eligibility queries.

name: chembl
description: ChEMBL bioactivity database — compound/drug/target search, bioactivities, mechanisms, ADMET.

name: biorxiv
description: bioRxiv/medRxiv preprints — search, metadata, published links, funder search, usage statistics.

name: variants
description: Human genetic variants — gnomAD population frequencies/constraint (r4), ClinVar records/search (direct NCBI), dbSNP, structural and mitochondrial variants.

name: clinical-genomics
description: Clinical genomics knowledge — ClinGen gene validity, dosage and actionability curations plus CIViC clinical evidence.

name: expression
description: Gene expression — GTEx tissue expression and eQTLs (pinned dataset).

name: regulation
description: Gene regulation — ENCODE experiments/files/biosamples, JASPAR transcription-factor binding matrices, UniBind TFBS.

name: protein-annotation
description: Protein annotation — InterPro/Pfam domains and families, Human Protein Atlas, STRING interaction networks.

name: rna
description: Non-coding RNA — Rfam families, seed alignments, covariance models, trees, sequence regions.

name: structures-interactions
description: Structures and molecular interactions — PDB structures, AlphaFold predictions, EMDB cryo-EM entries, Complex Portal complexes, IntAct interaction networks.

name: omics-archives
description: Omics data archives — ArrayExpress/BioStudies, GEO, MGnify, PRIDE proteomics projects.

name: genes-ontologies
description: Gene identity and ontologies — MyGene queries, OLS4 ontology terms, GO annotations (QuickGO), UniProt entries, Reactome pathways.

name: drug-regulatory
description: FDA drug data — Drugs@FDA applications, approvals, pharmacologic classes, generic equivalents, SPL drug labels.

name: research-resources
description: Research resources — Grants.gov funding opportunity search, Antibody Registry lookups.

name: synon-research
description: Independent Synon-research MCP — compact discovery and bounded execution of an operator-verified research capability pack without exposing each source as a separate Skill.

upstreams.name: OpenAI Life Science Research capability pack

name: cancer-models
description: Cancer genomics cohorts — cBioPortal studies, mutations, copy-number alterations, clinical attributes.

name: chemistry
description: Small-molecule chemistry — PubChem compounds/properties/similarity, ChEBI ontology, Rhea reactions, BindingDB affinities.

name: human-genetics
description: Human genetics associations — GWAS Catalog, eQTL Catalogue, FinnGen/BioBank-Japan PheWAS portals.

name: literature
description: Scholarly literature graph — OpenAlex works/authors/venues/citations, arXiv metadata.

name: genomes
description: Genome annotation — Ensembl REST lookup/sequence/homology/VEP, UCSC Genome Browser tracks and conservation.

name: cellguide
description: Cell type information from CELLxGENE — descriptions, marker genes, tissue distribution, source datasets.

name: zinc
description: ZINC22 purchasable chemical space (CartBlanche22) — compound lookup by ZINC id, SMILES exact/similarity search, supplier-code resolution, random sampling, 3D structure locations for docking.

name: omtx-om
description: Official hosted Om MCP — target-conditioned small-molecule ranking with LULA, accessible-space screening, molecule fulfillment, generated-data access and discovery diligence without local model deployment.
authHint: Sign in to Om through the hosted MCP OAuth flow. Scoring, data access and molecule orders are account-scoped; review each launch or credit-consuming action before approval.

name: patsnap-chemical-molecular
description: Official hosted PatSnap Chemical Molecular MCP — structure and similarity search, fragment and scaffold analysis, ADMET prediction, patent-linked compound intelligence and SAR extraction.
authHint: Create a PatSnap Open Platform API key and configure it here. The key is encrypted and injected only on the server side; PatSnap's documented Chemical Molecular MCP endpoint uses the apikey query parameter.

name: inductive-bio
description: Official hosted Inductive Bio MCP — small-molecule ADMET and PK property prediction for solubility, permeability, stability, efflux, CYP, hERG, BBB and related development risks without local model deployment.
authHint: Sign in to Inductive Bio through the hosted MCP OAuth flow. Prediction inputs and account-scoped models remain subject to the provider's terms; review every external call before approval.

name: boltz-api-official
description: Official hosted Boltz MCP — small-molecule and protein structure or binding prediction, library screening, binder design and ADME workflows without local model deployment.
authHint: Sign in to Boltz through OAuth or configure a workspace API key. Structure, screening and design jobs may consume credits and always require confirmation in Synon Biomed.

name: open-targets-official
description: Official hosted Open Targets Platform MCP — target/disease evidence, tractability, safety, genetics, drug mechanisms and clinical candidates through schema-guided GraphQL.

name: tamarind-bio
description: Hosted computational drug-design MCP — molecular and protein structure prediction, docking, protein/antibody/RNA design, molecular generation and property workflows without local GPU deployment.
authHint: Create a Tamarind API key in your Tamarind account. Compute jobs can consume account credits and always require confirmation in Synon Biomed.

name: adaptyv-cloud-lab
description: Official hosted cloud-lab MCP for protein and antibody validation — target catalog, experiment design, quotes, binding/affinity, expression, thermostability and structured results.
authHint: Sign in to Adaptyv Bio. Creating experiments, accepting quotes or making payments always requires confirmation in Synon Biomed.

name: ketcher-chemistry
description: Interactive 2D molecule sketcher (Ketcher) as an MCP App. Backs the .ket/.smi/.mol/.sdf/.rxn artifact viewer.

name: idc-rest
description: Public clinical imaging MCP — read-only cohort discovery, metadata, guarded SQL and citation-ready cancer imaging evidence. No API key or local data download required.
